name: SCRAP (Scroungers' Center for Re-usable Art Parts)
description: Low-cost donated arts, crafts, and educational materials, plus free workshops and material giveaways for educators
fullDescription: SCRAP is a San Francisco creative reuse nonprofit whose Arts & Education Materials Depot offers ever-changing, affordable donated materials for teachers, artists, students, and makers, plus free workshops and giveaways for educators.
whatTheyOffer:
- Fabric, yarn, and sewing notions
- Paper, scrapbooking, and school/office supplies
- Art and craft materials, beads, and frames
- Wood, metal, glass, and tile in the Materials Bay
- A free section
- Free monthly teacher workshops (with $25 of free materials) and twice-yearly free teacher giveaways
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the SCRAP Depot at 141 Industrial St. (Tuesday-Sunday, 10 am-6 pm)
2. Browse and buy low-cost materials
3. Educators can register for free teacher workshops and giveaways on Eventbrite
4. Donate materials Tuesday-Saturday (appointment needed for more than 2 boxes)
keywords: SCRAP, art supplies, craft supplies, fabric, textiles, paper, sewing, classroom materials, teacher discount, creative reuse, artist supplies, affordable art
